premises: Increasing Cr content in FeNiCrCoCu enhances formation of a protective, adherent oxide layer at high temperature.
A continuous, nanocrystalline oxide layer increases surface hardness and reduces defect nucleation during sliding.
The enhanced oxide layer limits microscopic plastic flow and localized deformation under sliding.
The oxide layer forms more readily and with improved adherence in the Cr-enhanced alloy.
